The structure of Mg6Ti2Mo2O16 (reduced formula Mg3TiMoO8) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3m (No. 166), with 26 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies octahedral coordination for Mg, Mo, Ti, and O centers, with Mg–O distances of 2.1144–2.2077 Å and O–Mg/Mo/Ti distances of 1.971–2.2077 Å. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 26 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Mg octahedra and corner-sharing between Mg and Mo octahedra.
